verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference and serving engine. A product like this could plausibly ship an assistant for configuring or operating it, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Tool calling, reasoning parsers and the OpenAI-compatible server are developer building blocks for building an assistant, not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
